notes.title: A massive missile strike against Ukraine - 10th October 2022 Dev update
notes.notes:
Hello

We are here today with an urgent report about the massive missile attack against cities all over Ukraine, including the capital Kyiv, where our team is located. This is how the day started for us:


Part of the team was already in the office, while other were getting ready to go to work or en route, when the first missiles hit Kyiv in the morning of October 10th. That was followed with several more rounds of attack. Overall, it was reported that 83 missiles of different types (43 shot down by AA defenses) and some kamikaze drones (some say 9 out of 10 destroyed by AA) were deployed in this attack. 

We decided that everyone could work from home, although some people were already at the office. That came in handy, as subway stopped for a few hours. 

As a person who lives in Kyiv my whole life and knows the city quite well, I can tell you that most places of the reported attacks does not make any sense in terms of military logic - its just some parks, squares or cars in the middle of the street, some tourist places as well. Nothing like an important military target, or even government building… The only explanation to that could be that the aim of these attacks is terror of civilians and an attempt to sow panic and chaos. 

Yet, some strikes did hit some power plants across the country, causing power shortages in several large cities (but not in Kyiv). Right now, I am writing this news update in my apartments in Kyiv, not knowing where the next Russian missiles would land…

Ukraine War Stories tells the story of the first month of the war. It would take more than one game to tell the story of this entire war… Still, if you want to know how everything started for the civilian people of Ukraine back in February - join us for the full release of our free title on 18 October 2022. 

The story of this war is far from over. Stand united, support Ukraine! 

With Best Regards from Kyiv
Oleksandr and the Starni Games team

notes.title: 8 Days to Release - Douglas A-1 Skyraider The US Attack Aircraft
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/735bfbb3c9f0ef7335b2984bba27902e6dad1c28.png[/img]

In the age of the turbojet, Douglas A-1 Skyraider flew as a piston-powered, propeller-driven blast from the past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/12bda2c534d744d6812578cee65c8d21ee4a0737.jpg[/img]

With the rapid development of jet aircraft towards the end of the war, dozens, if not hundreds of piston engine aircraft became obsolete. The Skyraider could have joined their lot, but its innovative turbo-compound engine gave it a chance to prove itself - and prove itself it did.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/500fbb2065c7709ed3a10144dbf984b50aac36e8.jpg[/img]

A solid, well-made and innovative at a time, Douglas A-1 would last well into the Vietnam War, only decommissioned in the 1970s. It was an attack aircraft that could shred ground targets with its 20-mm autocannons, carry out tactical bombings (with its payload capacity of 3600 kg) and deliver torpedo strikes equally well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/474ae69218b59df3733695829d035bdb30e3b894.jpg[/img]

There is no telling how effective Douglas A-1 would have been in WWII if it were finalized and deployed faster. And in Fight for Freedom, you’ll get to explore that exact possibility.

General! Two years have passed since the Strategic Mind series began with an Early Access for the Strategic Mind: The Pacific on 30 April 2019. So, here we are with all the hottest fixes and features from the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom.

[h2]Update 1.26[/h2]

[h3]New content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fully reworked naval combat tutorial - now it consists of 3 parts. 
[*] Overhauled 5-parts of the land operations tutorial, but the content is the same.
[*] All tutorial operations now work much better. It was hard to click certain hexes/units in tutorials before, and now these issues were fixed. [/list]
[h3]Game mechanic changes: [/h3]
[list][*] Overwatch fire now does take into account Line of sight. (Before it was only Spotting and Gun range). So, now the anti-tank guns can no longer Overwatch you “through” the building, city or forest, etc. They can only Overwatch you where they would have been able to fire normally. [/list]
[h3]Localization:[/h3]
[list][*] The game now has full Ukrainian text localization.[/list]
[h3]Quality of life improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added special “+” Overstrength indicator showing when each unit is eligible for an Overstrength.
[*] The terrain info screen now has two additional pieces of information: Line of Fire (Yes/No) and Combat penalty (Yes/No). 
[*] Added a “New hero available” notification when you get a new hero. You will see a flying label (similar to the “Level up available” one).
[*] Added hint to unit price when purchasing units with all the discount information so now you can see more clearly how different global bonuses, awards, and other things affect the final unit price.
[/list] 
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Infantry with Heavy equipment and no ground transport now cannot be deployed. (As it cannot move) The corresponding message box with an explanation is added.

[*] Fixed crash with Undo button during landing or take off - now it is unavailable after these actions.
[*] Fixed a rare issue that would lead to incorrect Line of Fire calculation in some cases.  
[*] Fixed crash when upgrading units with Airmobile skill. (Fallschirm to Pioneers for instance)
[*] Fixed an annoying sound that often happened during the loading screens.
[/list]
[h3]Misc:[/h3]
[list]

General!
Today we bring Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg up to date with the upcoming Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism title. We introduce a most-wanted feature, judging by the volume of players’ requests for it, the Undo move button.

[h2]Undo move[/h2]
Added the “Undo move” button. It allows you to retrace your unit's last movement. It is eligible, only if you want to change your last movement and the movement did not affect the current tactical situation. It is not eligible if: an attack happened, the spotting has changed, the objective status has changed, the unit embarked/disembarked, etc.

[h2]Optimization [/h2]
We are working on optimizing the game performance. So, far we successfully implemented a number of improvements. Some are still underway and will be added in future updates, as we keep working on the Strategic Mind series.

[h2]Korean language[/h2]
One of the players “piliaboar11” volunteered to create the Korean localization. It is not fully finished, but it’s 90+% done, so we decided to upload it with this update. This changelog is not an exhaustive list of changes, some minor improvements in other areas were also made, some bugs were fixed, and some localization inaccuracies corrected.
